description: Non-material amendment to planning permission ref: 2021/01060/FUL granted 16th August 2021 for the 'Change of use of part of the ground floor from retail shop (Class E) into an HMO (Sui Generis) to accommodate up to 10 residents along with associated excavation of a new basement including the formation of a new lightwell; change of use of the first and second floor level from dental surgery (Class E) into residential (Class C3), partial demolition of the existing building and erection of rear extensions at ground, first and second floor level in connection with the creation of 3 x 2 bedroom and 4 x 1 bedroom self-contained flats over first and second floor level; alterations to external facades to include the installation of new windows and door openings; replacement of all existing timber windows at first and second floor levels with timber sliding sash windows; alterations to the shopfront; erection of new boundary walls; formation of roof terrace at second floor level; provision of new cycle and bin stores' to allow amendments to the approved drawings to include: internal layout alterations and reconfiguration of the ground floor cycle and bin storage areas, internal layout changes to flats 3 and 5 to make bedrooms accessible through open plan living areas, infilling of the side entrance door to ground floor retail and infilling of the main entrance door surround comprising of glazing facing Tournay Road.
borough: London Borough of Hammersmith and Fulham
